problem: 不同正常工况产生模型相关且方向不固定的异常分数尺度偏移，使源域固定阈值不可迁移。
components: condition encoder: 从可观测工况标签或控制变量得到条件 c
backbone anomaly scorer: 任意正常样本训练的时间序列检测器
condition-specific normal score calibrator: 仅拟合独立正常 VIN 的条件尾分布
tail-probability anomaly score: -log survival(score | c)，用统一正常尾概率阈值报警
training_constraint: 不使用故障标签训练或选阈值；目标工况校准 VIN 与评价正常 VIN 必须 VIN 隔离。
design_decision_gate: 只有 CATC 在至少两个骨干和三 seed 下稳定降低跨工况 FPR，且保留或改善正常重校准 Recall，才将其升级为端到端条件化评分网络。
conclusion: Control-response conditional encoder did not improve over response-only scoring on seed 3407; do not promote it as proposed method.
candidate_method: RATC: response-aware (voltage/temperature) MTAD-GAT scoring plus target-normal empirical tail calibration; control variables excluded from anomaly score.
negative_control: Control-response conditional encoder did not outperform response-only scoring; retained as negative control.
mratc_candidate: M-RATC: response-only score, target-normal tail calibration when target normal VINs are available, and appended binary missingness indicators under value masking.
